# Active Session Working Notes

## Purpose
Real-time scratchpad for capturing thoughts, findings, and decisions during active development. This file is NOT committed to git - it's your personal workspace.

At the end of your session, summarize key findings into `../session-notes.md` and patterns into `../patterns-discovered.md`.

## Session End Checklist
Before ending your session:

- [ ] Review key findings above
- [ ] Add summary to `../session-notes.md`
- [ ] Document any new patterns in `../patterns-discovered.md`
- [ ] Commit session-notes.md and patterns-discovered.md
- [ ] Clear or archive these working notes for next session
